text: {"assertions":["A conflict loop bug in mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift caused clients to rewrite each other repeatedly when the same note was edited offline on two devices.","The conflict loop bug only manifested on the first request after a cold start.","The root cause of the conflict loop was an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The conflict loop was fixed in PR #1178 on the fix/conflict-loop-1 branch.","A property test was added to mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift to cover the conflict loop fix.","The conflict loop fix eliminated 87 duplicate rows per day that were previously being written."]}
